whatIs: Design Spells collects small, surprising design details: animations, transitions, Easter eggs and hidden nods in apps and sites. Each "spell" has its thumbnail, the source app and a description, and they're shown from newest to oldest.

You explore it with a row of tags such as Interaction, Easter Egg, Animation, 404, Confetti or Dynamic Island. It's useful when you're looking for specific examples of microinteractions, not whole sites.
uses: Look for animation ideas for a 404 page by filtering on the 404 tag.
See how well-known apps do confetti or a celebration after you complete an action.
Bring specific examples of a microinteraction to a design meeting to decide how to implement it.
caveats: It only has tags: there's no text search.
It shows the effect but doesn't explain how to implement it; you have to reproduce it on your own.
It covers individual details, so it's not useful for studying the design of a complete interface.
pricingNote: You can browse it without an account or payment; the only payment is sponsorship of the newsletter and the site.
idealFor: Developers and designers looking for specific microinteractions.
